description.value:
An eversweep appears no different than a normal broom but sweeps out negative energy and minor spirits with the grime.

A greater eversweep is crafted with sprigs of sage and angelica, and it also wards the space for 24 hours after its Full Sweep is complete. Creatures that live in the space or that are invited in gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws for as long as they remain in the cleaned area.

Activate—Full Sweep 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The broom takes on life, becoming an animated object that begins sweeping all on its own. Over the next hour, it cleans the floors and sweeps the cobwebs of all rooms connected to where it started its journey, though it won't burst through doors or move through existing wards. Once its task is complete, the eversweep returns to its usual designated resting place.
